annotations.text:
Second pass.
· Tabs on the stage — Message / Triage / Agent / Reply, each carrying only its own buttons.
· Rail rows are one line until hovered or clicked.
· No sync button; the nav tabs are centred on the window.
· State is an emoji, its word, and the card's left edge — no coloured pills.
· Buttons are the app's real MuiButton: 8px radius, 12.5px, weight 600.
＋ New now starts four things, not one: send something, give an agent a job, leave yourself a 💡 note, or ask for a report. All four appear on the rail at the minute you pressed it.
